summary: GLM-5.3 keeps decoding while a long prompt prefills
compatibility: No user action required. A long new prompt waits about twice as long for its first token while other requests are decoding; set PREFILL_COMPUTE_SHARE to change the balance.
details: The GLM-5.3 (744B) presets now set prefill-compute-share 0.4, as the GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash profiles do. Before, a long prompt's prefill took every engine step and the running requests nearly stopped.

glm53-csf-tp8 on 8x RTX PRO 6000, 16 decode streams and a 32K-token prompt every 20 s: decode during the prefill 61 to 409 tok/s, the prompt's time to first token 4.4 to 8.9 s; decode without prefills is unchanged.
